name: StandX DUSD
oneLiner: DUSD is StandX's delta-neutral synthetic dollar, redeemable 1:1 against USDT/USDC and backed by hedged BTC/ETH/SOL positions on CEXes via Ceffu custody.
collateral: USDT/USDC deposits converted to hedged crypto positions (BTC, ETH, SOL) via Ceffu
pegMechanism: Delta-neutral hedging on centralized exchanges; 1:1 USDT/USDC redemption

oracleRisk.summary: StandX documents multiple independent price feeds, median selection, deviation circuit breakers, secondary networks, TWAP fallbacks, and manual intervention for its managed collateral and hedging system.

branchApplicability.reviewer: Codex Safety Score V9 data research
branchApplicability.rationale: DUSD is minted from USDT or USDC into a managed vault and offchain hedging system, and redemption uses a seven-day unwind period. StandX monitors collateral, hedge positions, and liquidation triggers operationally, but users do not open permissionless per-collateral debt positions with independently inventoried onchain auction, backstop, and shutdown branches.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At Solana slot 425778638, the tracked Token-2022 DUSD mint reported H4Mp7WL282pdbY9V9N7AJnsQwB5yyrU1E7svfsH2Ur5h as both mintAuthority and freezeAuthority. That authority is a PDA owned by the immutable StandX program STANDKqqZERMKosYH2PAtNtnt6mig4CRPycsRwjuVhB, so the program can directly freeze individual DUSD token accounts and block their transfers. The separate BSC deployment remains governed through the StandX Gateway role system.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: StandX documents DUSD as chain-native on Solana and BNB Chain with StandX Gateway components handling minting and redemption. No third-party bridge route was verified, so the reviewed topology is issuer-native mint/redeem on each supported chain.

mintAuthority.summary: StandX DUSD uses an on-chain Gateway for USDT/USDC deposits. Solana mint authority is a PDA of an immutable program, and BSC's sole MINTER_ROLE is the Gateway controller proxy under a 3-of-4 DEFAULT_ADMIN Safe; the terminal Settler/RSV backend and BSC Gateway upgrade control chain are not fully enumerated.

controls.label: StandX BSC Gateway (sole MINTER_ROLE)
controls.evidence: 2026-07-20: a full RoleGranted/RoleRevoked log scan of the BSC DUSD token from deployment (block 47,000,000) through block 111,600,000 confirms MINTER_ROLE was granted to this Gateway controller proxy at block 47,451,545 and revoked from the deployer in the same transaction — it is the only MINTER_ROLE holder that has ever existed. Docs describe Gateway contract minting on USDT/USDC collateral deposit with a 7-day redemption lock.

controls.label: StandX BSC DEFAULT_ADMIN Safe (3-of-4)
controls.evidence: 2026-07-20: the previously unresolved 171-byte DEFAULT_ADMIN contract is a Gnosis Safe 1.1.1 proxy (masterCopy() = 0x29fcB43b46531BcA003ddC8FCB67FFE91900C762) with owners 0x222542fac5d6f5c2562312f907d202be807ee415, 0x955703b14f475bc0c53db9522283ba1bf1c8a8e1, 0x649b82c8de192e92f8dc9c88f63038016ce56310, and 0x56383a4af4482a708dbbac53bf03ad706028b203, threshold 3. The full role-event scan confirms DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE was granted to this Safe at block 48,266,832 and revoked from the deployer, with no later role events.

controls.evidence: The Settler manages delta-neutral positions across CEXes and the RSV Fund multisig bridges assets between on-chain and off-chain platforms; StandX can reject redemption orders, making the issuer backend a controlling party over the mint/redeem lifecycle.

review.evidence: StandX operates a two-layer model (on-chain Gateway + off-chain Settler/RSV multisig). Solana: at slot 425778638, DUSD mint DUSDt4AeLZHWYmcXnVGYdgAzjtzU5mXUVnTMdnSzAttM (Token-2022) has mintAuthority and freezeAuthority H4Mp7WL282pdbY9V9N7AJnsQwB5yyrU1E7svfsH2Ur5h, which is owned by StandX program STANDKqqZERMKosYH2PAtNtnt6mig4CRPycsRwjuVhB. StandX program has upgradeAuthority: None (immutable, programData 4XNF9sPKbX3SAor8mm8HDbWycw7qGC642NJs6mePqXQe at slot 425779135). Solana mint authority is a PDA of an immutable program. BSC: DUSD token 0xaf44a1e76f56ee12adbb7ba8acd3cbd474888122 has slot 0 = 0x2c02f575cdd0cc87de89ae6a493b05a5ed95065a (admin proxy pointing to implementation 0xdf09ebf9a24080deedb0a9a85db0b3aa9a90caa1); slot 1 of that proxy = 0x00b4f9b510893505acefb10ec91cbc972185088e (a second proxy pointing to 0xb69f4f80ec472ff9fe86933ac739329f8f72dc3b, a 31KB AccessControl+UUPS implementation). Partial role resolution on 2026-06-11 at BSC block 103642466: hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0x6c2404092cb1acfe9a06bc7de61bf619933edba5) = true (a 171-byte unverified contract, structure unresolved) and hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, 0x2c02f575…) = true (the Gateway controller proxy); hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, 0x6c2404…) = false. 2026-07-20 follow-up resolved both open questions: the 171-byte DEFAULT_ADMIN contract is a Gnosis Safe 1.1.1 proxy (masterCopy 0x29fcB43b46531BcA003ddC8FCB67FFE91900C762) with 4 owners and threshold 3, and a complete RoleGranted/RoleRevoked scan from deployment (block 47,000,000) through block 111,600,000 via bsc.lava.build found no role events after block 48,346,672 — MINTER_ROLE has only ever been held by the Gateway proxy 0x2c02f575cdd0cc87de89ae6a493b05a5ed95065a, and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE only by the Safe.
